title: Certify #4535 at a 13x smaller finite rank: N = 2^77,014,944,503 instead of 2^10^12 (same κ = 0.003020165)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/pr4535-smaller-rank/`. hexapode's #4535 (head `a6d7237f`) freezes its critical-root compiler word at `N = 2^(10^12)`. Its own certificate already gives absorption `L(N) < N^z` at

**`N = 2^77,014,944,503`, a 13.0× smaller exponent,**

with the same κ = 0.003020165 and the same parameters, root bracket and gap. This partly answers the "funded cutoff" open question of #4532 and #4535. **No new κ.**

## Why

Absorption needs only `ln A + p·ln(c + ln N) < (z − θ_hi) ln N`. The left side is about 24 nats at #4535's rank, against about 261 on the right, so the rank is far larger than needed.
- **#4535's own `ln A` bound.** Even with it, `(1−θ_lo) ln n0 ≤ 13.62`, the least certified rank is `2^90,180,626,561` (11.1×).
- **Sharper bound.** #4535's own definition `A = n0^(1−θ)/(c+ln n0)^p` gives `ln A ≤ 10.245`, and the least rank is `2^77,014,944,503`.

## Checks (own certified logarithms, exact rationals)

- **Minimal rank.** `K` is the least integer certified. The inequality fails at `K − 1000` even with the most favourable bounds, so `K` is minimal for these parameters.
- **Larger ranks.** It holds at every larger `N` (`z − θ_hi > p/(c+ln N)`), and `N > n0`.
- **Envelopes.** The frozen word's envelopes shrink accordingly. `G_depth` falls from 2·10^11 to 1.54·10^10, and `log₂ C_N` from 3.4·10^12 to 2.62·10^11.
- **Consistency.** At `K = 10^12` the margin is 240.17 nats (236.79 with the coarse `ln A`), consistent with #4535 and my #4536.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr4535-smaller-rank
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr4535-smaller-rank outcome=completed   (~2 s, stdlib only)
```

**Limitations:**
- Only the frozen rank changes. Physical constants, the outer cutoff and selection are untouched.
- `p`, `c`, `n0` and `d` are not retuned.

**Open questions:**
- Halving the outer slack `d` would cut `K` a further 1.8×, but needs a 54-predicate outer replay.
- A majorant retune needs #4532's gates rechecked at `θ`.

Head: `7db8ee8d97d456f120cb534d8cf356a1b8b02ca8`. Base: canonical main `f626db5c`.
